acceptanceCriteria: A change touching only _test.go files of package P selects P's tests and no importing units, unless an explicit declared dependency (e.g. testdata read scopes) requires more; the plan says why.
A change to a non-test file in P still selects importers (no regression).
A maintained affected fixture covers both; the affected spec records the rule.
body: Observed by the V1-0947 lane on 2026-10-07 (branch claude/v1-0947-mmap-unmap-evicted, base 0b5096ca): a change that adds only internal/contextindex/mapping_eviction_test.go made `corvint affected --base 0b5096ca0896351a584bca271812d9e1dd34f06c` select about 100 importing units. Go test files (package p or p_test) are compiled only into p's own test binary and cannot be imported by other packages, so only the owning package's tests (and any test-only fixture consumers declared explicitly) need to run. Not yet reproduced by the coordinator; treat as suspected until a fixture confirms it. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1.
